lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct white vertical lines are visible; the spacing between the first and second anterior lines is noticeably wider than the regular spacing observed across the mid-torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The sixth and seventh lines from the anterior are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 5 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch and posterior flank area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a short geometric segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral curvature projecting posterodorsally from the frontal bone at approximately a 45-degree angle before curving inward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.5 times the combined pixel width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two symbiotic birds (oxpeckers), one perched on the dorsal midline and one in flight near the anterior hoof; prominent white chevron between the eyes and white spot markings on the rostrum.
